slot.subtopic: Range of a sin + b cos
slot.brief: Find the range of a sin θ + b cos θ + c and decide which value in the options lies outside it.

stem: For real $\theta$, which value is not in the range of $3\sin\theta+4\cos\theta+1$?

verdicts.working: The sinusoidal part has amplitude $\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$, so the full range is $[1-5,1+5]=[-4,6]$. Thus $7$ is not in the range.

working:
$3\sin\theta+4\cos\theta\in[-\sqrt{3^2+4^2},\sqrt{3^2+4^2}]=[-5,5]$; hence the range is $[-4,6]$.

Independent check: The sinusoidal part has amplitude $\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$, so the full range is $[1-5,1+5]=[-4,6]$. Thus $7$ is not in the range.
solution:
The amplitude of $3\sin\theta+4\cos\theta$ is $\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$, so
$$3\sin\theta+4\cos\theta+1\in[1-5,1+5]=[-4,6].$$
Hence $7$ is not in the range.
